title.narrative: Reduce TB incidence and mortality in Uzbekistan by increasing quality of TB care - Uzbekistan (01-Jul-2016-30-Jun-2018)

description.narrative: Uzbekistan, Tuberculosis, Republican DOTS Centre Ministry of Health of the Republic of Uzbekistan (RDC)This program has the following goals: By 2020 reduce the MDR burden by 50 % compared to 2014 levels. By 2020 reduce the TB incidence rate to 38 per 100,000 population. By 2020 reduce the TB-related death rate to 2,6 per 100,000 population. The objectives of this program are: To Improve quality of TB treatment in adults and children by securing an uninterrupted supply of internationally quality assured first and second line anti TB drugs, including the relevant pediatric formulations and IPT for children and PLHIV. To increase detection of TB and M/XDR TB by providing access for all TB patients to Xpert testing, with follow-on SL DST for all patients with R resistance. To prevent nosocomial transmission
